problem: So that it never lands on you
action: Evening. The dealer stands squarely on his own forecourt under the canopy, feet planted, facing towards camera but with his eyes just off lens. Hands relaxed at his sides. Upright, steady, in charge of his own place. This is the most confident he looks in the entire film.
lighting: Warm low evening sun coming in under the canopy behind him, rim-lighting his shoulders and head, his face filled softly from the front. Handsome, dignified light.
camera: Waist-up, he is centred in the vertical frame, larger than in any other shot. Sharp. Background soft. 35mm.
detail: No signage, no lettering, no logos, no number plates anywhere in frame. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Dignity restored. He is not grateful — he is simply in control of his own pump again.
motion: He breathes in once and his chest settles. A very slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks, he does not look directly down the lens.

voice_over.hi: आप पर एम-डी-जी न लगे। बस यही हमारा काम है।
